description: DRAFT for review (2026-11-04). Behavioural replication of the post's Experiment 8 MATH-500 result for the published 50-pass edit (p50c), from public artifacts. Not approved, not frozen, nothing executed. See docs/wsp/exp8-replication-protocol.md.
claim_scope: qualified replication of the published p50c checkpoint's MATH-500 behaviour (decided 2026-11-04); NOT an independent reproduction of the controller's discovery of the edit
claim_wording: Replication of the published p50c checkpoint's MATH-500 behaviour under the authors' released evaluation settings, using the multimodal Qwen3.5-0.8B release in place of the authors' unreleased text-only export, on a different engine version and hardware. This is not a reproduction of the edit's discovery.

decisions.decision: Proceed with the qualified MATH-500 replication on the published multimodal checkpoints, with the claim_wording above. Other benchmarks (GSM8K, IFEval, ...) get separate protocols.
conditions: Choose the engine and versions, hardware, MATH-500 revision and grading implementation BEFORE approving drift bounds and the agreement criterion.
Approve drift bounds, the agreement criterion and min_meaningful_effect BEFORE collecting confirmatory results.
The required_limitations stay in every report.

proposed_arms.status: proposed; pending budget and a separate protocol decision (not part of this protocol's runs)
proposed_arms.description: Text-only checkpoint reconstructed by Tantular from the release: the model.language_model.* tensors of Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B@2fc06364 (and the p50c edit for an edited counterpart) with the export config.json published in the logs (git blob f1b52bb0503dae9c6e89f65853a767f0bc72e153). Purpose: bound the effect of the model class and loading path on identical weights. It is a Tantular reconstruction, not the authors' export, and cannot remove the untouched-weights limitation.
proposed_arms.cost: roughly one additional arm of MATH-500 generation per reconstructed checkpoint; not budgeted

analysis.missing_policy_note: proposed: matches the authors' score (truncated or unboxed answers are incorrect). Harness errors are additionally reported per arm; the authors' evaluate.py aborted a job on abnormal finishes instead.
secondary_endpoints: token-limit rate (finish_reason == 'length'; truncation proxy, not proof of looping)
analysis.agreement_with_published: REPLACE (criterion against the post's 7.9% -> 48.1% and 93.0% -> 33.1%; to be approved after engine/hardware/dataset/grader are chosen and before confirmatory results)
required_limitations: The comparison of the published base and edited checkpoints verifies what changed within those files; it cannot establish that the authors' unreleased text-only export had identical untouched weights.

The published multimodal release (Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration) was evaluated in place of the authors' text-only export (Qwen3_5ForCausalLM); the export's tokenizer.json and generation_config.json handling are not reproduced exactly.
The edited checkpoint is a third-party rebuild (copied from ML-Intern-lab); its identity is established only by the tensor checks recorded for this run.
Engine and library versions and hardware differ from (or are unknown for) the authors' run; only statistical, not output-level, replication is attempted.
Not a reproduction of the controller's discovery of the edit; the agent harness is not released.
